assets.prompt:
A classic pyramid-shaped mechanical metronome in polished walnut, seen exactly straight on from the front, perfectly symmetrical, standing upright and filling the canvas top to bottom with a small margin. The front face is a tall recessed cream panel with a vertical scale of evenly spaced fine tick marks (no numbers). There is NO pendulum, rod or weight anywhere: the face panel is empty apart from the tick marks. Near the bottom of the face, centred left-to-right, a small round brass pivot screw sits exactly at 50% of the width and 83% of the height. A slightly wider walnut base at the bottom. Clean, warm practice-room illustration: polished walnut wood, brushed brass, cream and ivory, soft studio lighting with a gentle highlight from the upper left, crisp simple shapes with subtle painterly shading, like a premium modern app illustration. Friendly and calm. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one. Fully transparent background.
Portrait canvas with aspect ratio 2:3. Empty cream face. Pivot screw exactly at (50%,83.33%).
assets.note: The app rotates the separate pendulum image over this one, pivoting on the brass screw at (400, 1000) in an 800×1200 canvas. Exact symmetry and the pivot position matter more than detail; small offsets can be corrected in asset-list data.
assets.correction_prompt: Edit target: the attached metronome body. Preserve its walnut body, cream empty face, tick scale, symmetry and lighting. Remove ALL background lighting, glow, haze and backdrop: only the metronome itself on true transparent background. Move the brass pivot screw DOWN to exactly 50% width and 83.33% height of the full canvas, in the upper area of the walnut base below the cream panel. No rod or pendulum. Preserve 2:3 aspect ratio. Keep the feet entirely visible.

assets.prompt:
Just the pendulum of a mechanical metronome, isolated: a single thin, perfectly straight, perfectly vertical polished brass rod running down the exact centre of a tall narrow canvas, from about 3% from the top to a round brass hub whose centre is at 96% of the height. A sliding brass weight shaped like a small trapezoid with a centre notch sits on the rod at about 30% of the height. Seen straight on, symmetrical, nothing else in the picture. Clean, warm practice-room illustration: polished walnut wood, brushed brass, cream and ivory, soft studio lighting with a gentle highlight from the upper left, crisp simple shapes with subtle painterly shading, like a premium modern app illustration. Friendly and calm. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame or border unless the prompt asks for one. Fully transparent background.
Tall 1:5 canvas. Keep the rod and hub entirely within the middle fifth of the width if the tool requires a wider canvas; isolated transparent margins on both sides. Thin vertical straight rod. Hub centre at 96% height.
assets.note: The app rotates this about the hub centre (100, 960) in a 200×1000 canvas. The rod must be exactly vertical and centred left-to-right.
